title: Pure Eldlich
summary: Pure Eldlich the Golden Lord control strategy revolving around the endless cyclical loop between Golden Land Trap Monsters and Eldlixir Spells/Traps, supported by the 2025 support wave and generic staples. By sending Spells and Traps to activate Golden Lord's non-destruction removal and revival, the deck establishes an unbreakable wall of recurring Zombies and high-impact negation.

summary.title: Starters
points: Cursed Eldland pays 800 LP on activation to search any Eldlich monster or Golden Land Spell/Trap from your Deck to hand, and sends a Golden Land or Eldlixir card from Deck to GY when sent from field to GY.

Eldlich the Golden Lord sends itself and a Spell/Trap from hand to GY to send any card on the field to the GY without destroying; from the GY, sends a Spell/Trap you control to add itself to hand, then Special Summons a Zombie from hand with +1000 ATK/DEF and effect-destruction immunity.
Eldlixir of Scarlet Sanguine Special Summons an Eldlich monster (or any Zombie) from your Deck or GY, and banishes itself from the GY during your turn to Set a Golden Land Spell/Trap from Deck.
Eldlixir of Black Awakening Special Summons an Eldlich monster from hand or Deck in Defense Position, and banishes from GY to Set a Golden Land card.

summary.title: Opening: Cursed Eldland + Eldlixir of Scarlet Sanguine
steps: Activate Cursed Eldland, paying 800 LP to search Eldlich the Golden Lord from your Deck.
Activate Eldlich the Golden Lord in hand, sending itself and a card to the GY to send an opponent's card to the GY (or send Eldland to trigger its mill).
Set Eldlixir of Scarlet Sanguine and Conquistador of the Golden Land.
During the opponent's turn, activate Eldlixir of Scarlet Sanguine to Special Summon Eldlich the Golden Lord from your GY.
Chain Conquistador of the Golden Land, Special Summoning it as a Level 5 Zombie monster and destroying 1 face-up card on the field since you control Eldlich the Golden Lord.
During the End Phase, banish Conquistador from your GY to Set another Eldlixir directly from your Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Eldlich the Golden Lord anchors the board with 3500 ATK when revived by its own effect, completely immune to destruction by card effects.
Eldlich the Mad Golden Lord is an indestructible Level 10 Fusion that tributes a Zombie monster as a Quick Effect to take permanent control of an opponent's face-up monster.
Fallen Angel of the Golden Land is a 2025 Fusion that Special Summons an Eldlich monster from Deck, Extra Deck, or GY whenever it leaves the field.
Conquistador of the Golden Land destroys 1 face-up card on the field on summon while Eldlich the Golden Lord is face-up.
Huaquero of the Golden Land banishes 1 card from either player's GY on summon while Eldlich the Golden Lord is face-up.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Golden Land Forever! tributes a Zombie monster while you control an Eldlich monster to negate any Spell, Trap, or monster effect activation and destroy it.
Eldlixir of the Glorious Golden Land Special Summons itself as a Level 10 Zombie monster that bounces an opponent's monster, or banishes from GY to Set a banished Golden Land or Eldlixir card.
Seven Cities of the Golden Land performs Fusion Summons using Zombie monsters and locks an opponent's Set Spell/Trap from being activated each time a Zombie is Special Summoned.
El Dorado Adelantado recycles three banished Eldlixir or Golden Land cards into the Deck to either wipe all cards on the field, halve the opponent's LP, or draw 3 cards.
